userStories.title: Register heartbeat router and add workspace list + toggle + history endpoints
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need heartbeat API endpoints to list all routines, toggle pause/resume, and fetch execution history.
acceptanceCriteria: Import and register heartbeat_router in orchestrator/api/main.py (it exists in heartbeat.py but is NOT registered)

Add GET /api/heartbeat/{heartbeat_id}/executions endpoint — returns last N executions (default 10) with status, started_at, completed_at, duration, error_message

userStories.title: Create activity_service.py backend to merge chats, heartbeats, and recipe executions
userStories.description: As a backend developer, I need a service that merges all execution types into a unified activity feed.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/services/activity_service.py with ActivityService class

get_feed() method: queries chats (from chat sessions), heartbeat_executions, and recipe_executions tables, maps each to a unified ActivityFeedItem dict with fields: id, type (chat/routine/recipe), name, status, started_at, completed_at, duration_seconds, agent (id, name, avatar_url), summary, source_id, source_url, trigger, channel, step_progress, error_message
Merges all sources, sorts by started_at DESC, applies optional filters (type, status), paginates with limit/offset
get_stats() method: returns working_now (running count), channels_live (from settings/channels), completed_today (completed in last 24h), needs_attention (failed + stale)
Period parameter supports 1d, 7d, 30d, 90d
All queries filter by workspace_id
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow existing service pattern from orchestrator/services/. Use SQLAlchemy queries. Chat sessions may be in a different table — check the chats API for the right model.

userStories.title: Create /api/activity/feed and /api/activity/stats API endpoints
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need REST endpoints to fetch the unified activity feed and hero stats.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/api/activity.py with FastAPI router prefix='/api/activity'
GET /api/activity/feed — query params: type (csv), status (csv), period (1d/7d/30d/90d), limit (default 20), offset (default 0). Returns paginated list of ActivityFeedItem dicts
GET /api/activity/stats — query param: period. Returns {working_now, channels_live, completed_today, needs_attention, period}
Register activity_router in orchestrator/api/main.py
Both endpoints use get_request_context_hybrid() for auth
Returns proper HTTP error codes (401, 500)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create use-activity-api.ts hooks for feed and stats with polling

acceptanceCriteria: Create frontend/hooks/use-activity-api.ts following the pattern from use-workflow-api.ts
